	data = self.view.custom.calculation.table.selection.data
	addCheckNames = ["'%s\%s'"%(item['chkItemGroupName'], item['chkItemName']) for item in data]

	self.view.custom.calculation.info.formula = formula
	
	return

customMethods.name: saveChkItem
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("saveChkItem() called")
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	chkItemInfo = dict(self.view.custom.value)
	if self.view.custom.chkTypeName == 'Calculated':
		calcInfo = self.view.custom.calculation.info
		chkItemInfo['calculation'] = system.util.jsonEncode({"formulaType":calcInfo.formulaType, "script":calcInfo.script, "values":calcInfo.formula})	

	# sort out the chkItem specification
	specInfo = self.view.custom.specification.specInfo
	specType = specInfo['specType']
	if specType:
		spec = {}
		spec['specType'] = specType
		spec[specType] = dict(specInfo[specType])
		chkItemInfo['specification'] = system.util.jsonEncode(spec)
	else:
		chkItemInfo['specification'] = None
		
	# sort out the chkItem picklist values
	if self.view.custom.value.pickListId is not None:
		pickListValues = self.view.custom.pickListValues
		pickListName = self.view.custom.pickLists[str(self.view.custom.value.pickListId)]['pickListName']
		system.perspective.print("pickListName %s"%pickListName)
		pickListValue = pickListValues[pickListName] if pickListName == 'Tree' else system.util.jsonEncode(pickListValues[pickListName])
		chkItemInfo['pickListValues'] = pickListValue if pickListName else None
	
	if self.view.custom.chkTypeName == 'Trigger':
		chkItemInfo['measCount'] = 1
		chkItemInfo['required'] = False

	if chkItemInfo['chkItemId'] is None: 
		self.view.params.value.chkItemId = system.kanoa.quality.config.addCheck(chkItemInfo, userId)
		if self.view.params.value.chkItemId is not None: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Check Item added"})
		else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Failed to add Check Item"})		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Check Item added"})

		if self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkShtVersionStateName != 'Draft':
			change = "Check Item %s added"%(chkItemInfo['chkItemName'])
			system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': chkItemInfo['chkShtId'], 'change': change}, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	else:
		compareInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChecks({'chkItemId': chkItemInfo['chkItemId']}), 0)
		if all((dict(chkItemInfo).get(k) == v for k, v in dict(compareInfo).items())):
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "No changes found. No need to save"})
			return #Don't save if nothing has changed
		
		retVal = system.kanoa.quality.config.updateCheck(chkItemInfo, userId)
		if retVal > 0: 
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': "Check Item updated"})
			self.logChanges(compareInfo, chkItemInfo)
		else: 
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Failed to update Check Item"})

	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshCheckItems', {'chkShtId':self.view.params.value.chkShtId})
		
	return

customMethods.name: logChanges
customMethods.script:
def norm(v):
		# (Optional) normalize to reduce noisy diffs: treat '' like None, trim strings, etc.
		if (v or None) is None: return None
		# Coerce Java BigDecimal/Long/etc. to Python primitives if needed
		try:
			from java.lang import Number
			if isinstance(v, Number):
				# keep ints as int, decimals as float
				i = int(v)
				if float(v) == float(i): return i
				return float(v)
		except:
			pass
		if isinstance(v, basestring): return v.strip()
		return v

	if self.view.custom.chkShtInfo.chkShtVersionStateName == 'Draft': return	# Only log changes to currently released checksheets

	# Ensure plain dicts
	old = dict(compareInfo)     # values currently in DB
	new = dict(chkItemInfo)      # values you intend to save
	
	# Build list of changes
	changes = []
	excludeKeys = []
	
	# Keys present in both: modified?
	for k in set(old.keys()).intersection(new.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue
		ov = norm(old.get(k))
		nv = norm(new.get(k))
		if ov != nv: changes.append(("modified", k, old.get(k), new.get(k)))
	
	# Keys only in _new: added
	for k in set(new.keys()) - set(old.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue		
		changes.append(("added", k, None, new.get(k)))
	
	# Keys only in _old: removed
	for k in set(old.keys()) - set(new.keys()):
		if k in excludeKeys: continue		
		changes.append(("removed", k, old.get(k), None))
		
	# If nothing changed, bail out (keeps your early-return behavior)
	if not changes:	return  # Don't save if nothing has changed
	
	# Log each change
	for kind, key, oldVal, newVal in sorted(changes, key=lambda t: t[1].lower() if isinstance(t[1], basestring) else t[1]):
		if (oldVal or None) == (newVal or None): continue
		change = "Check Item %s %s field %s old value: %r new value: %r"%(chkItemInfo['chkItemName'], key, kind, oldVal, newVal)
		system.kanoa.quality.sheet.addChangeLog({'chkShtId': chkItemInfo['chkShtId'], 'change': change}, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	
	return
